# ䷊ Hexagram 11 — 泰 Tài (Peace)

## Judgment — 卦辭

**小往大來，吉亨。**

The small departs, the great approaches. Good fortune and success. Heaven and earth mingle — the creative descends, the receptive rises. Their energies meet and all things flourish.

```
━━━━   ━━━━
━━━━   ━━━━
━━━━   ━━━━
━━━━━━━━━━━
━━━━━━━━━━━
━━━━━━━━━━━
```

## Image — 大象

**天地交泰，后以財成天地之道，輔相天地之宜，以左右民。**

Heaven and earth unite: the image of peace. The ruler shapes and completes the way of heaven and earth, assists the proper order of heaven and earth, and so aids the people on every side.

## Lines — 爻辭

**Line 1** · 初九：拔茅茹以其彙，征吉。
Pulling up rushes — they come together in a cluster. Undertaking brings good fortune. When the time is right, like-minded people move forward together.

**Line 2** · 九二：包荒，用馮河，不遐遺，朋亡，得尚于中行。
Bearing with the uncultivated, crossing the river by force if necessary, not neglecting what is distant, abandoning partisan ties — thus one holds to the middle way.

**Line 3** · 九三：無平不陂，無往不復。艱貞無咎。勿恤其孚，于食有福。
No plain without a slope, no going without a return. Perseverance in difficulty brings no blame. Do not worry about sincerity — in nourishment there is blessing. Every peak of prosperity contains the seed of its turning.

**Line 4** · 六四：翩翩不富以其鄰，不戒以孚。
Fluttering, not wealthy, together with one's neighbors. Without admonition, through sincerity. In times of peace, those above descend without pretense to join those below.

**Line 5** · 六五：帝乙歸妹，以祉元吉。
Emperor Yi gives his daughter in marriage. Blessing and supreme good fortune. The ruler connects above and below through humble generosity.

**Line 6** · 上六：城復于隍，勿用師。自邑告命，貞吝。
The city wall falls back into the moat. Do not use the army. From the town itself comes the command. Perseverance brings regret. Peace has collapsed from within. Force cannot restore it now.
